---
name: CIMTool Spike (Time-Boxed Investigation)
about: Propose a time-boxed investigation to answer a technical question or reduce risk before committing to an enhancement
title: "[SPIKE] "
labels: spike
assignees: ''

---

### What question does this spike need to answer?

A clear and concise statement of the question, uncertainty, or risk to be resolved. (e.g. "Is it technically feasible for CIMTool to ...", "Which of approaches A or B should CIMTool adopt for ...")

### Background and motivation:

Why the question matters now, and what is blocked or at risk until it is answered. Include links to related issues, standards, or external tools.

### Scope and approach:

What will be investigated, prototyped, or measured, and what is explicitly out of scope.

### Time box:

The maximum effort or calendar time to be spent before stopping and reporting findings (e.g. "two weeks", "five working days").

### Expected outcome:

What the spike will produce. For example:
- a written summary of findings, posted as a comment on this issue
- a throwaway prototype on a branch
- a recommendation, including any approaches that were ruled out and why
- follow-on [ENHANCEMENT] or [DEFECT] issues for the work the spike justifies

### Done when:

The criteria that close this spike. A spike is complete when the question is answered, even if the answer is "not feasible", not when a feature is delivered.

### Additional context:

Add any other context, references, or screenshots useful to the investigation.
